corrupt_state.expected_behavior: startup verification detects the broken signature and the release refuses to serve rather than starting over corrupt state, leaving the corrupted chain and every other committed file exactly as it found them; once the harness repairs the record the same state directory boots, is ready, and the session accepts a turn
corrupt_state.injection: one signed audit record of the committed session is edited in place while the host is stopped, then the release is restarted against that state
corrupt_state.observed_behavior: the release refused to start: configuration error: existing audit chains failed signature verification; committed files the refused start changed: none; after repair /v1/ready returned 200 and a turn on the session returned 200

full_disks.expected_behavior: the turn fails with a stable bounded error instead of a partial write, the session keeps everything it had committed, every other committed session, sandbox and audit chain is untouched, and the host serves that session again once space is reclaimed
full_disks.injection: the state filesystem is filled to ENOSPC before a turn on the session that holds the committed conversation (62914560 bytes of ballast until errno 28)
full_disks.observed_behavior: the turn under ENOSPC returned 500; /v1/ready returned 503; the turn after reclaiming space returned 200

interrupted_writes.expected_behavior: after the documented lease-expiry wait, the atomic replace discipline leaves the committed conversation exactly as it was and every other committed file intact, the uncommitted write is not adopted on restart and its scratch file is removed, and the release becomes ready and accepts a new turn on that session
interrupted_writes.injection: a Linux LD_PRELOAD rename observer stops the host as it replaces the committed session's conversation file: after the new conversation is written in full to a scratch file and before the rename; the harness verifies the stopped PID, the committed file still in place and the scratch bytes, then SIGKILLs the host's process group
interrupted_writes.observed_behavior: the interrupted turn ended as "RemoteDisconnected('Remote end closed connection without response')"; after restart /v1/ready returned 200 and a new turn returned 200; committed file changed or uncommitted write adopted: False; scratch files left after the restart: none

network_failures.expected_behavior: the turn fails with a stable gateway error within its deadline, without disclosing transport diagnostics; readiness is unaffected, the next turn on the same session succeeds, and the session keeps everything it had committed
network_failures.injection: the completion endpoint accepts the connection and closes it without a response, so a turn on the session that holds the committed conversation fails at the transport rather than with a status
network_failures.observed_behavior: the turn returned 502 'agent_failure'; /v1/ready returned 200; the turn after the fault cleared returned 200

runtime_crashes.expected_behavior: the detecting call fails with stable 502 agent_failure, retiring the compiler without replaying uncertain side effects; a separate next call on the same session obtains a replacement, succeeds, and readiness passes; the session keeps everything it had committed
runtime_crashes.injection: SIGKILL every forge child of the running host, then a turn on the session that holds the committed conversation
runtime_crashes.observed_behavior: killed forge children [2449, 2450, 2451, 2452]; the detecting call returned 502; a separate recovery turn returned 200 and /v1/ready returned 200

unavailable_model_providers.expected_behavior: the turn fails with the stable 502 agent_failure carrying no provider diagnostics, readiness stays up because the dependency is external, the next turn on the same session succeeds once the provider returns, and the session keeps everything it had committed
unavailable_model_providers.injection: the configured completion endpoint answers every request with 503 overloaded_error for the duration of one turn on the session that holds the committed conversation
unavailable_model_providers.observed_behavior: the turn returned 502 'agent_failure'; /v1/ready returned 200; the turn after recovery returned 200

provider.description: an Anthropic-shaped endpoint on loopback that the drill switches between healthy, unavailable and reset; no request leaves this host

wiring.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: a placeholder: no request reaches a real provider
wiring.PI_AUTH_FILE: one credential for the drill's tenant: scopes chat and ops:read, no tools, valid for an hour
wiring.PI_ENDPOINT: the drill's stand-in provider, on loopback
wiring.PI_PORT: an unused loopback port for each boot
wiring.PI_STATE: a fresh state directory for each category
